detail: Hard rule 3's runtime enforcement point is unasserted: flipping the labelled arg to True stamps DEMO on every real landlord report while all tests stay green. P1 wiring coverage at this hop: 0%.
recommended_fix: In pdf_download_writes_audit_log_test, compare the handler's PDF body (via normalize_metadata) against a fresh generate(watermark: False) render of the same report_data.

title: Committed demo PDFs and pdf_prebake.main's watermark: True unverified — tests re-render via generate and never read the served bytes
detail: The mechanism is pinned, but the served artifacts and the producing main() call are unguarded: a regressed or stale re-bake ships unwatermarked demo PDFs (violating the 2026-08-24 ruling) with a green suite.
recommended_fix: Add a test reading 1–2 committed priv/static/demo/report-*.pdf files and asserting normalized equality with a fresh generate(watermark: True) render of the same payload.

title: Watermark-on-every-page (rule 3) is asserted only by construction — the cover's explicit place can be deleted with all tests green
detail: Rule 3 demands DEMO on every page. Presence tests compare whole-document bytes; removing the cover's explicit place loses the cover watermark while both presence tests still pass.
recommended_fix: Assert watermark content per page (e.g. page-wise comparison of marked vs plain renders), or document reliance on background-by-construction plus the committed vision-verified sample.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 100% (seam outcomes: golden real-mode identity, watermark presence on two demo paths, mutation-verified). P1 ~25% (handler flag NONE, served demo bytes PARTIAL). Overall ~65%. P1 <80% → FAIL.
recommended_fix: Add the handler-body assertion and the committed-demo-bytes pin (~10 lines each in existing test files); both lift P1 to 100% and flip the gate to PASS.
